name: NotebookLM
summary: External synthesis capability candidate for organizing approved source documents and extracting grounded summaries.

source.notes: Registered as a candidate synthesis service. No files are uploaded or processed by this ticket.

useWhen: A research or knowledge ticket needs synthesis across approved source documents.
The ticket explicitly allows use of an external document-synthesis service.
doNotUseWhen: Sources include secrets, credentials, customer data, production data, or private evidence without explicit approval.
The output would replace human strategic judgment.
routing.fallback: Synthesize directly from repository artifacts and cite source files.

inputs.name: approvedSourceSet
inputs.description: Explicit list of approved source documents or artifacts.
inputs.sourceOrDestination: Repository or approved external source list

outputs.name: groundedSynthesis
outputs.description: Summary, themes, contradictions, and source references.

schemas.notes: Future knowledge-runtime work may normalize synthesis outputs.

cost.costDriver: External account limits, service terms, or paid features.

risks.description: Document upload can move private information outside the repository.
risks.mitigation: Require explicit source approval and avoid secrets, customer data, and private evidence.

governance.dataBoundary: Only approved public or non-sensitive documents may be used unless explicitly approved.
governance.sensitiveActionBoundary: NotebookLM synthesis is not customer evidence, legal advice, compliance proof, or final strategic decision.
governance.loggingRequirement: Record source set, limitations, and whether external synthesis was used.
governance.updatePolicy: Review before first operational use and whenever service behavior or terms change.

review.reviewNotes: Future candidate only until privacy and source-boundary behavior is reviewed.

examples.scenario: A research ticket provides approved public PDFs for synthesis.
examples.expectedUse: Use NotebookLM only if the ticket approves external synthesis and source boundaries are clear.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not upload private founder notes, credentials, customer data, or production artifacts.
